title: Day 4 — Loops: Bar-Bar Karo Code Ko Repeat
preamble: Aaj hum loops ke baare mein seekhenge. Loops ka istemal tab hota hai jab aapko ek hi code block ko baar-baar chalana ho. Inke zariye aap repetitive tasks ko automate kar sakte hain, jisse aapka time aur mehnat bachti hai. Hum `for`, `while`, aur `do-while` loops ke baare mein detail se jaanenge aur samjhenge ke har loop ka istemal kab aur kaisa hota hai.

sections.label: Concept
sections.content: Loops ka concept programming mein bahut zaroori hai. Jab aapko ek hi tareeqe ka code baar-baar chalana ho, tab loops ka istemal hota hai. Teen main types ke loops hote hain: `for`, `while`, aur `do-while`. `for` loop tab best hota hai jab aapko pehle se pata ho ke kitni baar repeat karna hai, jaise ke ek array ke har element ko print karna. `while` loop tab use hota hai jab aapko condition check karni ho aur jab tak wo condition true ho, tab tak loop chalana ho. `do-while` loop mein pehle loop chalaya jata hai phir condition check ki jati hai, isliye yeh guarantee deta hai ke loop kam se kam ek baar to chalega hi.

sections.label: Example
Practice
sections.content: Ab aap ek program likhiye jo user se ek number input le aur uske table (1 se 10 tak) ko print kare. Yeh `while` loop ka istemal karke kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh exercise aapko loops ke practical istemal samjhne mein madad karegi.

sections.label: Mini Project
sections.content: Ek simple calculator banaiye jo user se do numbers aur ek operator (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`) input le. Phir loop ke zariye result calculate kare aur bar-baar chalne de jab tak user "exit" na type kare. Is project se aapko loops ke istemal ka poora practical experience milega aur aap seekh sakte hain ke kaise user input ko handle karna hai aur loop ko control karna hai.
